summary.name: Pica AI
summary.one_liner: Pica AI is a web-based photo tool that enhances image quality, swaps faces, restores old photos, and generates AI headshots.
use_cases: enhance blurry or low quality photos
restore old or damaged family photos
create professional headshots for LinkedIn or resumes
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Pica AI as a set of online tools for photos. The Enhance feature improves image quality with one click. The Face Swap feature swaps faces online for free. The Restore Old Photos feature is listed as a way to repair older images. The AI Headshot Generator turns selfies into headshots suited to LinkedIn, resumes, and profiles. The page does not give details on models, output resolution, or privacy.
notable: AI headshot generator for professional profiles
Photo Enhancer has been upgraded to Artguru as of 2025-10-31
caveats: The Photo Enhancer has been upgraded to Artguru on 2025-10-31, so the older enhancer name may be outdated
The page does not state which features require payment; pricing is taken from the directory listing as freemium
